description: Translates text or a text file (.txt, .md, .srt, .vtt, .csv) between en, ro, de, fr, es, it, pt, nl, pl, hu, cs, bg, uk, tr, ru with OPUS-MT and M2M100 AI models, on this machine. Lines, paragraphs and subtitle timings are kept. The source language is detected when left out. The first call installs Transformers.js with ONNX Runtime (about 450 MB); each model is downloaded once (OPUS-MT about 113 MB, M2M100 about 632 MB).

output.description: For a file, default <name>.<to><ext> next to it

text.description: Text to translate, instead of a file

name: translate
title: Translate text offline
